I answered Pree in a thread on her #central-team message: the ticket for the gate kiosk outage at Marrow Agrisupply is **OPS-8962**.

- **How the number changed:** on Oct 14, Tobias first posted OPS-7941 in #central-team (the Juniper work). Later that day he corrected it in #central-random to OPS-8962, because the customer changed the number on the call.
- **A number to avoid:** the #5335 Tobias posted in #central-team on Oct 16 is for a gate kiosk outage at Marrow Fieldworks, a different account. I warned her about it in the reply.

Pree is a member of both channels, so she can see everything I used. I got these posts from the brain's saved messages: they didn't come up when I read the channel directly.
